title: Authored LPC Runtime Atlas Activation
changes: Corrected the Z32 runtime-loader contradiction that disabled the authored terrain-map-v7 tuple atlas whenever licensed LPC source sheets were mounted.
Made the exact authored tuple atlas mandatory in both direct-source and compatibility configurations.
Kept the generated same-family autotile lane disabled when licensed LPC sources are available without disabling the authored tuple atlas.
Added the mapped tuple atlas JSON and PNG to normal-build required runtime assets and rebuilds them from the pinned source when absent.
Updated startup diagnostics and content-integrity checks to detect any future tuple-atlas bypass.

validation.expectedWindowsLog: Loaded authored LPC terrain-map-v7 tuple atlas
